audience: camps, after-school programs and class providers that take registrations in Jumbula

useCases.title: Find overdue and failed installment payments
useCases.text: List the payment installments with their due dates, amounts, status and payment errors. Open the order of each overdue or failed one to see its details.

useCases.title: Look up an order and its registration form
useCases.text: Search orders by family name, email or confirmation id. Read the registration form answers for the order, and open a signed waiver by its id.

useCases.title: Check the payments behind a disputed charge
useCases.text: List payment transactions with their amounts, dates and status. Open the related order to compare the charge with what the family registered for.

useCases.title: Find a family and its participants and parents
useCases.text: Search family accounts by parent email, phone, participant name or external id. Read the contact details, participants and parents or guardians of one family.

useCases.title: Review the registrations for a season or program
useCases.text: Search orders by season, program or status. Review the order details returned to see who has registered for a camp or class.

useCases.title: Create or change a discount coupon
useCases.text: Create a coupon code that families enter at checkout, or change its fields later. Changes go live at once and can cut real prices.
